items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: The only other tenors in town that I knew of... were Paul Besey

ctx.x: Well, I think also somewhere there's a story that Bud was impressed by Beesey. So you've mentioned. He might have. Bud, Beesey, the sparkling ivory keys and the shiny horn and some of those things I think have come out in later years as a possible influence on Bud.
Also, Beesey had a fantastic slap tongue, and that always intrigued any saxophone player.
There have been some Columbia records, Paul Beesey's trio. Do you happen to know who the other people are? No, I've got the records.
